# `web.new/` Audit — Gap Report Against `web/`

*Comparison generated by reading every file in `web.new/` and matching it against `UI-FEATURE-INVENTORY.md`.*

## Top-line verdict

**The `web.new/` rewrite is a visual prototype, not a feature-complete redesign.** Its own `README.md` says so explicitly:

> Sessions, processes, files, and console output are currently **mocked** in `view-*.jsx` and `app.jsx`. Swap these for fetches against your supervisor backend (`/api/sessions`, `/api/procs`, WebSocket for console streams).

There is **no backend integration**, **no WebSocket**, **no auth**, **no maintenance / interactive-Claude flow**, and **no editor / xterm vendor libraries**. The UI shell looks great but every interactive feature listed in `UI-FEATURE-INVENTORY.md` needs to be wired up before this can replace `web/`.

What is present: the six-tab layout, page header, theme/accent/density tweaks, sample sparklines and per-core bars, a sortable Processes table, list/grid toggle for Files, a multi-tab fake terminal that streams hard-coded vite log lines, and a session detail "sheet" with auto-scroll + find. That's the entire feature surface.

The rest of this document is a section-by-section gap report.

---

## 1. App shell (`app.jsx`)

| Item | `web/` | `web.new/` | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 tabs with hash routing | yes — `#sessions`/`#files`/etc., supports `#sessions/new/<folder>`, `#console/<path>` deep links | tabs only — `useState` not `location.hash`, no deep-linking, no sub-routes | **Missing** |
| Latency badge with color thresholds | green <100ms / amber 100–300 / red >300 / `…` stale | shows fake `latency` ms from `setInterval`, single accent color, no thresholds, no stale state | **Missing** |
| Connection dot | live ↔ offline based on real WS | hard-coded "online" green dot | **Missing** |
| WebSocket auto-reconnect | exponential backoff 500→15000ms, re-subscribes topics, ping/pong every 5s | no WS at all | **Missing** |
| Restart banner | pending → reload-ready, sessionStorage-backed, 5min staleness | no banner, no flow | **Missing** |
| `?` key opens maintenance modal | yes | no global key handler at all | **Missing** |
| `g s/f/c/p/y/t` chord nav | yes (800ms window) | no | **Missing** |
| Help button → maintenance modal | yes (`#help-btn`) | help icon-button is a no-op | **Missing** |
| Header action slots | wired per-view (Sessions: New session; Console: New shell) | hard-coded conditional `+` buttons in `app.jsx`, also no-ops | **Partial** (visual) |
| `view.destroy()` on tab change | yes — clean teardown, no stale subs | React unmounts handle it but also clears all per-view in-memory state (filter, search, sort, etc.) | **Regression** (state lost on tab switch) |
| `document.startViewTransition` | yes with fallback | no | **Missing** |
| Theme/accent applied as `data-*` on `<html>` | yes; updates `<meta theme-color>` | yes — but does NOT update `theme-color` meta | **Partial** |

Notes worth pulling forward:
- `app.jsx` has its own `TWEAK_DEFAULTS` block intended for an iframe-based "edit-mode" host (see `tweaks-panel.jsx` `__edit_mode_*` postMessage protocol). This is dev-tooling, not a user feature — fine to keep but it's not a replacement for the real Settings view.

## 11. Automation flows (server + client)

These are the most operationally important behaviors and they are **all missing** in `web.new/` because the redesign is purely client-side mock.

| Flow | Status |
|---|---|
| **Interactive Claude hand-off (Maintenance modal)** | **Missing entirely** — no modal, no `/api/maintenance/interactive`, no clipboard copy, no `localStorage.consoleActivateShell`, no auto-navigate to Console |
| **Auto-trust PTY flow** (cached folder check, ANSI strip, Enter on prompt, 1.2s grace, 8s timeout) | Server-side — unchanged. But the trigger (Maintenance modal) doesn't exist in the new UI |
| **Phase 1 auto-type** (`claude\r` 800ms after shell created) | Server-side — unchanged |
| **Phase 2 auto-paste** (1500ms quiet detection, newlines collapsed, 15s fallback) | Server-side — unchanged |
| **Console activates correct shell on mount** (reads `localStorage.consoleActivateShell`, removes key) | **Missing** — Console view doesn't check localStorage |
| **Pre-prompt stdin injection** (800ms delay, write to stdin) | Server-side — unchanged. UI doesn't collect a pre-prompt |
| **Self-restart** (start.bat detached spawn, 500ms flush, process.exit(0)) | Server-side — unchanged. UI has Restart button but no flag-write before POST |
| **Restart banner** (sessionStorage flag → pending → reload-ready) | **Missing** — banner doesn't exist |

The server side of these flows is in `server/` and untouched, so they will still work — but **none of the UI entry points exist**. The `?` key, the help button, the Maintenance modal, the `consoleActivateShell` localStorage read, the Restart banner, the sessionStorage flag write, and the prePrompt collection in New Session are all gone.

## 12. Quick wins to bring `web.new/` to parity

Roughly in priority order. Each item is a UI feature that exists in `web/` and needs to be re-implemented in `web.new/`:

1. **Wire the WebSocket and real APIs.** Without this, every list/card/metric is a lie. Use the same topic names and HTTP routes; keep the existing server.
2. **Bring back the login page.** Auth-gate is required.
3. **Add a real Modal stack** (`modal.js` equivalent) — every other feature needs it: confirm dialogs, prompts, new-session form, folder picker, key picker, trash modal, password-confirm for power buttons, maintenance modal.
4. **Bring back the Maintenance ("Request a change") modal**, the `?` key, and the `consoleActivateShell` localStorage read in Console. Without these, "open in interactive Claude" is dead.
5. **Restore the Restart banner** + `sessionStorage.supervisorRestarting` writes around any restart action.
6. **Restore New Session modal** with folder browse, command mode, pre-prompt textarea, env vars, save-as-preset, and the folder picker layered modal.
7. **Restore Session Detail features** that are operationally critical: send-to-stdin row (interactive Claude needs it), Send-to-Claude action, prev/next match navigation in find, real WS log streaming with 10MB cap.
8. **Replace the fake terminal with xterm.js** + fit addon, real `shell:*` topics, scrollback replay, customizable quick keys with all 6 types and the key picker.
9. **Restore Files view almost entirely** — preview pane (image/audio/video/PDF/archive/markdown/text/binary-hex), CodeMirror, markdown renderer, sidebar with pinned + recent + trash, breadcrumbs that handle Windows paths, sort modal with per-folder persistence, create menu, folder menu, full selection toolbar, clipboard paste bar, trash modal, upload progress toast, FS event subscription.
10. **Restore Settings backend half**: push notifications, disk-low threshold, pinned folders with reorder, auto-trust toggle, session presets, hidden files, blocklist, account (password + logout), maintenance repo path, backup (export/import/reset), force-refresh.
11. **Restore System view extras**: GPU card, network sparklines, power buttons with password confirm modal, top-procs link, ≥90% disk danger color, live `system` WS topic.
12. **Restore Processes view**: 8s auto-refresh, 200-row cap notice, kill confirm with PID.
13. **Restore global keyboard shortcuts**: `?` and `g s/f/c/p/y/t` chord nav.
14. **Restore utility helpers**: `confirmModal`, `promptModal`, `attachLongPress` (500ms + 8px cancel + vibrate), `attachPullToRefresh`, `fmtBytes` full ladder, `fmtDur` full ladder, `fmtRelative`/`fmtAbs`, `copyToClipboard` with fallback.
15. **Restore service worker behavior**: periodic update check (5 min), reload-on-controllerchange.
16. **Hash-based routing** with sub-paths (`#sessions/new/<folder>`, `#console/<path>`) and `view.destroy()` semantics so per-view state isn't blown away on every tab switch.

## 14. What `web.new/` adds that isn't in `web/`

For completeness — these are net-new and may be worth keeping in the redesign:

- **Density control** (`dense`/`medium`/`airy`) — adds breathing room option.
- **Aurora background** — soft animated gradient (pure visual).
- **Lime accent** color (6th option vs. 5).
- **Live-bars chip animation** for running session status — nicer than a static dot.
- **Donut/ring** progress visual on stat cards (instead of just %).
- **Glass summary header** on Processes (count / total CPU / total MEM).
- **Tweaks panel** (`tweaks-panel.jsx`) — dev tooling for design iteration via `__edit_mode_*` postMessage protocol. Useful for the design phase, can be left in or stripped before ship.
- **Inter + JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts CDN** — `web/` ships nothing custom. Cleaner typography out of the box.
- **CSS-driven `data-screen-label`** showing `01 Sessions` etc. — purely cosmetic.

## How to use this audit

1. Treat `UI-FEATURE-INVENTORY.md` as the spec.
2. Treat this file as the punch list. Every "Missing" or "Partial" row is a task.
3. The biggest blocker by far is **no API/WS integration** — once that's in, most features in Sessions / Processes / System unlock cheaply. Files and Console are larger lifts because they need vendor libraries (CodeMirror, xterm.js, PDF.js, highlight.js) that the new code doesn't reference at all.
